required_facts.text: The exact clock time when irrigation actually started for the first zone in that week.

cases.unanswerable_reason: The entire family gives a planned order and calendar dates but no actual clock-time record of that week's first irrigation. The required actual start time is therefore absent.
forbidden_inferences: Do not turn the scheduled date into evidence of actual commencement.
Do not use the 18:00 reservoir-reading time as an irrigation start time.
Do not invent a midnight or morning start from the calendar date.
limitations: The supplied record is a planning meeting. Its schedule does not establish later execution time.
